rv.q: Jon Brittain’s transgender tale is a very good romantic comedy indeed, full of laughs and sadness and knotty ideas that it untangles with enormous empathy alongside a fizzing sense of fun.
This is a production of rare elegance and heart.
Nevertheless this production is not flawless.

cn.t: Critics praise this transgender romantic comedy for its empathy, humor, and knotty ideas, though one finds it less successful. The show balances laughs with poignant moments in an engaging story that handles complex themes with wit.
